name: anticipating-shadow-points
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the Anticipating Shadow Points (ASP) plugin. Install: /plugin marketplace add ulissesflores/anticipating-shadow-points, then /plugin install anticipating-shadow-points@anticipating-shadow-points

plugins.name: anticipating-shadow-points
plugins.description: Plan before you code: research, a pre-mortem against the MAST checklist of 14 failure modes, an independently checked plan and tasks with acceptance tests; optional execution in a separate claude -p session under your own permissions and a budget you set.
